size.note: Direct fetch of evisa.mfa.am (Armenia's official e-visa portal, Ministry of Foreign Affairs) homepage returned only contact info and navigation — no photo specification text was present on the accessible page. Third-party aggregators disagree sharply on the digital photo pixel size (600x600px vs 6000x6000px claims seen across different sources), which is itself a signal that none of them are reliably grounded in the actual portal content. Per the truthfulness gate, this field is left unverified rather than reporting a guessed number. The passport-specific 35x45mm spec (see am-passport.json, source mcs-citizenship.am) is NOT carried over here because Armenia's e-visa is a digital-only submission and may use a different spec than the physical passport photo.
